entries.name: MetricCodes.projection_certificate
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {D d : ℕ} (P : MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily X D d) (C : Finset X) (t : X → X → ℝ) (q : X → E) {s lam : ℝ}, 0 < d → s < 1 → s < lam → (∀ x ∈ C, t x x = 1) → (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, x ≠ y → t x y ≤ s) → (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, inner ℝ (q x) (q y) = (t x y - lam) * P.overlap x y) → ↑C.card ≤ (1 - s) / (lam - s) * (↑D / ↑d)

entries.name: MetricCodes.projection_certificate_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {D d : ℕ} (P : MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily X D d) (C : Finset X) (t : X → X → ℝ) (q : X → E) {s lam : ℝ}, 0 < d → s < 1 → s < lam → (∀ x ∈ C, t x x = 1) → (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, x ≠ y → t x y ≤ s) → (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, inner ℝ (q x) (q y) = (t x y - lam) * P.overlap x y) → ↑C.card * (lam - s) * ↑d ≤ (1 - s) * ↑D

entries.name: SpherePacking.directionalDerivative_radialPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n) = 2 * SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x

entries.name: SpherePacking.directionalDerivative_radial_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * p) = 2 * SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * p + SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.exists_maximal_sphericalCode

entries.name: SpherePacking.factorialLogError_eq

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteGramCertificate_auxiliary_sum_lower
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (certificate : SpherePacking.FiniteGramCertificate n k L) (C : SpherePacking.SphericalCode n s), (SpherePacking.Jacobi.topEigenvalue n k L - s) * ∑ x ∈ C.points, ∑ y ∈ C.points, SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel certificate.fibre x y ≤ ∑ x ∈ C.points, ∑ y ∈ C.points, SpherePacking.auxiliaryFiniteGramKernel certificate s x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteGramCertificate_shift_identity
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} (certificate : SpherePacking.FiniteGramCertificate n k L) {x y : SpherePacking.Euclidean n}, x ∈ SpherePacking.unitSphere n → y ∈ SpherePacking.unitSphere n → (inner ℝ x y - SpherePacking.Jacobi.topEigenvalue n k L) * SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel certificate.fibre x y = SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel (SpherePacking.certificateFibreBasis n k) certificate.boundary x y + SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel (SpherePacking.certificateFibreBasis n k) certificate.remainder x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteGramCertificate_shift_sum_nonnegative
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (certificate : SpherePacking.FiniteGramCertificate n k L) (C : SpherePacking.SphericalCode n s), 0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ C.points, ∑ y ∈ C.points, (inner ℝ x y - SpherePacking.Jacobi.topEigenvalue n k L) * SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel certificate.fibre x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteGramCertificate_sphericalCode_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ}, 3 ≤ n → k ≤ L → ∀ (certificate : SpherePacking.FiniteGramCertificate n k L) {s : ℝ}, s ≤ 1 → s < SpherePacking.Jacobi.topEigenvalue n k L → ∀ (C : SpherePacking.SphericalCode n s), ↑C.points.card ≤ (1 - s) / (SpherePacking.Jacobi.topEigenvalue n k L - s) * (↑(SpherePacking.truncatedHarmonicDimension n k L) / ↑(SpherePacking.Gegenbauer.fibreDimension n k))

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteGramFibreAmplitude_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 3 ≤ n → ∀ (k L : ℕ) (v : SpherePacking.Jacobi.Space k L), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ (i : SpherePacking.Jacobi.Index k L), 0 ≤ v.ofLp i) → ∀ (i : SpherePacking.Jacobi.Index k L), SpherePacking.finiteGramFibreAmplitude n k L v i ^ 2 = SpherePacking.finiteGramRecurrenceWeight n k L v i / SpherePacking.finiteGramRecurrenceNormalization n k L v

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteGramFibreAmplitude_sq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 3 ≤ n → ∀ (k L : ℕ) (v : SpherePacking.Jacobi.Space k L), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ (i : SpherePacking.Jacobi.Index k L), 0 ≤ v.ofLp i) → ∑ i, SpherePacking.finiteGramFibreAmplitude n k L v i ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → {F : Type u_3} → {E : Type u_4} → [inst : Fintype ι] → [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] → [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] → [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ F → (α → F →ₗ[ℝ] E) → α → α → ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel_eq_trace
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ F) (A : α → F →ₗ[ℝ] E) (x y : α), SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel b A x y = (LinearMap.trace ℝ F) (LinearMap.adjoint (A x) ∘ₗ A y)

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel_finset_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ F) (C : Finset α) (A : α → F →ₗ[ℝ] E), SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel b (fun x => ∑ x ∈ C, A x) () () = ∑ x ∈ C, ∑ y ∈ C, SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel b A x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel_positive
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ F) (A : α → F →ₗ[ℝ] E), SpherePacking.PositiveDefiniteKernel (SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel b A)

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel_three_channel
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (basis : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ F) (P M R : α → F →ₗ[ℝ] E) (a b : ℝ), (∀ (x y : α) (i : ι), inner ℝ ((P x) (basis i)) ((M y) (basis i)) = 0) → (∀ (x y : α) (i : ι), inner ℝ ((P x) (basis i)) ((R y) (basis i)) = 0) → (∀ (x y : α) (i : ι), inner ℝ ((M x) (basis i)) ((R y) (basis i)) = 0) → ∀ (x y : α), SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel basis (fun z => a • P z + b • M z + R z) x y = a ^ 2 * SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel basis P x y + b ^ 2 * SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel basis M x y + SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel basis R x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidt_trace_cauchy
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (C : Finset α) (A : α → E →ₗ[ℝ] E), (∑ x ∈ C, (LinearMap.trace ℝ E) (A x)) ^ 2 ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ x ∈ C, ∑ y ∈ C, SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel b A x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.finite_linear_programming_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (C : Finset α) (f : α → α → ℝ) {c B : ℝ}, 0 < c → 0 ≤ B → (∀ x ∈ C, f x x ≤ B) → (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, x ≠ y → f x y ≤ 0) → ↑C.card ^ 2 * c ≤ ∑ x ∈ C, ∑ y ∈ C, f x y → ↑C.card ≤ B / c

entries.name: SpherePacking.fischer_harmonicInner_eq_polynomialInner

entries.name: SpherePacking.fischer_harmonicInner_self_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (p : ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n k)), SpherePacking.Fischer.harmonicInner n k p p = 0 ↔ p = 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.fischer_homogeneousInner_radial_laplacian
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (p : ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m)) (q : ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2))), SpherePacking.Fischer.homogeneousInner n (m + 2) ((SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication n m) p) q = SpherePacking.Fischer.homogeneousInner n m p ((SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m) q)

entries.name: SpherePacking.fischer_polynomialInner_radial_harmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ) (q : ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n k)), SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * p) ↑q = 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.fischer_polynomialInner_sub_left
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q r : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n (p - q) r = SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n p r - SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n q r

entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (k + 1))), ↑((SpherePacking.harmonicAxisLift hn k x) p) = (SpherePacking.harmonicAxisProjectionOperator n k x) ↑p

entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (k : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (k + 1))) (q : ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (k + 2))), SpherePacking.Fischer.harmonicInner n (k + 2) ((SpherePacking.harmonicAxisLift hn k x) p) q = SpherePacking.Fischer.harmonicInner n (k + 1) p ((SpherePacking.harmonicDirectionalDerivative n (k + 1) x) q)

entries.name: SpherePacking.harmonicAxisProjectionOperator_mem_harmonic

entries.name: SpherePacking.harmonicAxisProjectionOperator_pair_axis
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ (p : ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (k + 1))), SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n ((SpherePacking.harmonicAxisProjectionOperator n k x) ↑p) (SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * ↑p) = SpherePacking.Fischer.harmonicInner n (k + 1) p p + (1 - 2 * (SpherePacking.harmonicAxisProjectionDenominator n k)⁻¹) * SpherePacking.Fischer.harmonicInner n k ((SpherePacking.harmonicDirectionalDerivative n k x) p) ((SpherePacking.harmonicDirectionalDerivative n k x) p)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousExponentFinset_card
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), (SpherePacking.homogeneousExponentFinset n m).card = (n + m - 1).choose m

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian
entries.statement: (n m : ℕ) → ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2)) →ₗ[ℝ] ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (p : ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2))), ↑((SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m) p) = (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) ↑p

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian_ker
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), (SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m).ker = Submodule.comap (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2)).subtype (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n).ker

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian_ker_map
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), Submodule.map (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2)).subtype (SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m).ker = SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (m + 2)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian_surjective
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (m : ℕ), Function.Surjective ⇑(SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian_surjective_of_fischer_adjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (m : ℕ), (∀ (q : ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2))) (p : ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m)), SpherePacking.Fischer.homogeneousInner n m ((SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m) q) p = SpherePacking.Fischer.homogeneousInner n (m + 2) q ((SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication n m) p)) → Function.Surjective ⇑(SpherePacking.homogeneousLaplacian n m)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication
entries.statement: (n m : ℕ) → ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m) →ₗ[ℝ] ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ (m + 2))

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (p : ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m)), ↑((SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication n m) p) = SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * ↑p

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication_injective
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (m : ℕ), Function.Injective ⇑(SpherePacking.homogeneousRadialMultiplication n m)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousSubmodule_eq_supported_exponents
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m = AddMonoidAlgebra.supported ℝ ℝ ↑(SpherePacking.homogeneousExponentFinset n m)

entries.name: SpherePacking.homogeneousSubmodule_finiteDimensional
entries.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), FiniteDimensional ℝ ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin n) ℝ m)

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel
entries.statement: {n k L : ℕ} → (SpherePacking.Euclidean n → SpherePacking.CertificateFibre n k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] SpherePacking.CertificateAmbient n k L) → SpherePacking.Euclidean n → SpherePacking.Euclidean n → ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel_diag
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} (f : SpherePacking.Euclidean n → SpherePacking.CertificateFibre n k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] SpherePacking.CertificateAmbient n k L) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel f x x = ↑(SpherePacking.Gegenbauer.fibreDimension n k)

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} (f : SpherePacking.Euclidean n → SpherePacking.CertificateFibre n k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] SpherePacking.CertificateAmbient n k L) (x y : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), 0 ≤ SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel f x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel_trace_cauchy
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} (f : SpherePacking.Euclidean n → SpherePacking.CertificateFibre n k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] SpherePacking.CertificateAmbient n k L) (C : Finset (SpherePacking.Euclidean n)), (↑C.card * ↑(SpherePacking.Gegenbauer.fibreDimension n k)) ^ 2 ≤ ↑(SpherePacking.truncatedHarmonicDimension n k L) * ∑ x ∈ C, ∑ y ∈ C, SpherePacking.isometricPackingKernel f x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometric_mixed_gram_trace_cauchy
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (C : Finset α) (f : α → F →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E), (↑C.card * ↑(Module.finrank ℝ F)) ^ 2 ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ x ∈ C, ∑ y ∈ C, SpherePacking.mixedHilbertSchmidtKernel b (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometric_mixed_kernel_diag
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} {E : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ρ] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [inst_7 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (bE : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (bF : OrthonormalBasis ρ ℝ F) (f : α → F →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x : α), SpherePacking.mixedHilbertSchmidtKernel bE (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) x x = ↑(Module.finrank ℝ F)

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometric_mixed_kernel_eq_overlap
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} {E : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ρ] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [inst_7 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (bE : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (bF : OrthonormalBasis ρ ℝ F) (f : α → F →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x y : α), SpherePacking.mixedHilbertSchmidtKernel bE (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) x y = SpherePacking.finiteHilbertSchmidtKernel bF (fun x_1 => LinearMap.adjoint (f x).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (f y).toLinearMap) () ()

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometric_mixed_kernel_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} {F : Type u_4} {E : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ρ] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_5 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_6 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [inst_7 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (bE : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (bF : OrthonormalBasis ρ ℝ F) (f : α → F →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (x y : α), 0 ≤ SpherePacking.mixedHilbertSchmidtKernel bE (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) (fun z => (f z).toLinearMap) x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.isometric_projection_trace
entries.statement: ∀ {F : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F] [inst_5 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (f : F →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E), (LinearMap.trace ℝ E) (f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.adjoint f.toLinearMap) = ↑(Module.finrank ℝ F)

entries.name: SpherePacking.kissingNumber
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ∞

entries.name: SpherePacking.log_add_choose_div_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (a b n : ℕ), Real.log ↑((a + b).choose a) / ↑n = Real.log ↑(a + b).factorial / ↑n - Real.log ↑a.factorial / ↑n - Real.log ↑b.factorial / ↑n

entries.name: SpherePacking.mem_harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), p ∈ SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n k ↔ p.IsHomogeneous k ∧ ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p) = 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.mem_homogeneousExponentFinset
entries.statement: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ), d ∈ SpherePacking.homogeneousExponentFinset n m ↔ Finsupp.degree d = m

entries.name: SpherePacking.mem_tangentHarmonicSubmodule
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), p ∈ SpherePacking.tangentHarmonicSubmodule n k x ↔ p.IsHomogeneous k ∧ (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p = 0 ∧ (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) p = 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.mixedHilbertSchmidtKernel
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → {F : Type u_3} → {E : Type u_4} → {G : Type u_5} → [inst : Fintype ι] → [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] → [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] → [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup G] → [inst_6 : InnerProductSpace ℝ G] → [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] → [FiniteDimensional ℝ G] → OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ G → (α → F →ₗ[ℝ] E) → (α → F →ₗ[ℝ] G) → α → α → ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.mvPolynomial_pderiv_commute
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) p) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p)

entries.name: SpherePacking.orthogonal_three_channel_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (p m r : α → E) (a b : ℝ), (∀ (x y : α), inner ℝ (p x) (m y) = 0) → (∀ (x y : α), inner ℝ (p x) (r y) = 0) → (∀ (x y : α), inner ℝ (m x) (r y) = 0) → ∀ (x y : α), inner ℝ (a • p x + b • m x + r x) (a • p y + b • m y + r y) = a ^ 2 * inner ℝ (p x) (p y) + b ^ 2 * inner ℝ (m x) (m y) + inner ℝ (r x) (r y)

entries.name: SpherePacking.packingConstant
entries.statement: ℕ → ENNReal

entries.name: SpherePacking.packingConstant_eq_SpherePackingConstant
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), SpherePacking.packingConstant n = SpherePackingConstant n

entries.name: SpherePacking.packingConstant_le_radial_linear_program
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → SpherePacking.packingConstant n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (CohnElkies.linearProgram n)

entries.name: SpherePacking.packingConstant_sharp_binary_asymptotic_upper
entries.statement: ∃ e, Filter.Tendsto e Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, SpherePacking.packingConstant n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ (-(CohnElkies.criticalBinaryExponent + e n) * ↑n))

entries.name: SpherePacking.pderiv_axisPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (i : Fin n), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x) = MvPolynomial.C (x.ofLp i)

entries.name: SpherePacking.pderiv_directionalDerivative
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (i : Fin n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) p) = (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p)

entries.name: SpherePacking.pderiv_radialPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n) = 2 * MvPolynomial.X i

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_C_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) (MvPolynomial.C c * p) = MvPolynomial.C c * (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p = ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p)

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_axisPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) (SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x) = 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_axis_mul_for_tangent
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) (SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * p) = 2 * (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) p + SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_directionalDerivative
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) ((SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) p) = (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) ((SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p)

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), p.IsHomogeneous m → m ≤ 1 → (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p = 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_isHomogeneous
entries.statement: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), p.IsHomogeneous m → ((SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p).IsHomogeneous (m - 2)

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) (p * q) = (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p * q + 2 * ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) p * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) q + p * (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) q

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_radialPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n) = MvPolynomial.C (2 * ↑n)

entries.name: SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian_radial_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), p.IsHomogeneous m → (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * p) = MvPolynomial.C (2 * (2 * ↑m + ↑n)) * p + SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.positiveDefiniteKernel_finset_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (I : Finset ι) (K : ι → α → α → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ I, SpherePacking.PositiveDefiniteKernel (K i)) → SpherePacking.PositiveDefiniteKernel fun x y => ∑ i ∈ I, K i x y

entries.name: SpherePacking.positiveDefiniteKernel_of_features
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (v : α → E), SpherePacking.PositiveDefiniteKernel fun x y => inner ℝ (v x) (v y)

entries.name: SpherePacking.radialPolynomial
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.radialPolynomial_isHomogeneous
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), (SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n).IsHomogeneous 2

entries.name: SpherePacking.radialPolynomial_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n ≠ 0

entries.name: SpherePacking.scaled_log_factorial_identity
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ), m ≠ 0 → n ≠ 0 → Real.log ↑m.factorial / ↑n - ↑m / ↑n * Real.log ↑n = ↑m / ↑n * (SpherePacking.factorialLogError m + Real.log (↑m / ↑n) - 1)

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 3 ≤ n → ∀ (k r : ℕ), 0 < SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale n k r

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale_succ
entries.statement: ∀ (n k r : ℕ), SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale n k (r + 1) = SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale n k r * (2 * ↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2) * (↑r + 1) * (↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2)

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale_zero
entries.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale n k 0 = 1

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → ℕ → SpherePacking.Euclidean n → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_fischer_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ (p q : ↥(SpherePacking.tangentHarmonicSubmodule n k x)) (r : ℕ), SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) ↑p) ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) ↑q) = SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisFischerScale n k r * SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n ↑p ↑q

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_fischer_inner_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ (p q : ↥(SpherePacking.tangentHarmonicSubmodule n k x)) (r : ℕ), SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r + 1)) ↑p) ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r + 1)) ↑q) = (2 * ↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2) * (↑r + 1) * (↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2) * SpherePacking.Fischer.polynomialInner n ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) ↑p) ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) ↑q)

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_harmonic_and_directional
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ}, p ∈ SpherePacking.tangentHarmonicSubmodule n k x → ∀ (r : ℕ), (SpherePacking.polynomialLaplacian n) ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) p) = 0 ∧ (SpherePacking.directionalDerivative n x) ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) p) = MvPolynomial.C (↑r * (↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 3)) * (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r - 1)) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_isHomogeneous
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ}, p.IsHomogeneous k → ∀ (r : ℕ), ((SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) p).IsHomogeneous (k + r)

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_mem_harmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), ‖x‖ = 1 → ∀ {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ}, p ∈ SpherePacking.tangentHarmonicSubmodule n k x → ∀ (r : ℕ), (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) p ∈ SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (k + r)

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_one_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x 1) p = MvPolynomial.C (SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2) * SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * p

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_succ_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n k r : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r + 1)) p = MvPolynomial.C (2 * ↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2) * SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) p - MvPolynomial.C (↑r * (↑r + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 3)) * SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r - 1)) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_succ_succ_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n k r : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r + 2)) p = MvPolynomial.C (2 * ↑(r + 1) + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 2) * SpherePacking.axisPolynomial n x * (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x (r + 1)) p - MvPolynomial.C (↑(r + 1) * (↑(r + 1) + SpherePacking.harmonicAxisParameter n k - 3)) * SpherePacking.radialPolynomial n * (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x r) p

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift_zero_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℝ), (SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisLift n k x 0) p = p

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisPolynomialIsometry
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → 3 ≤ n → (k r : ℕ) → (x : SpherePacking.Euclidean n) → ‖x‖ = 1 → ↥(SpherePacking.tangentHarmonicSubmodule n k x) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] ↥(SpherePacking.harmonicHomogeneousSubmodule n (k + r))

entries.name: SpherePacking.solidHarmonicAxisPolynomialLift

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient_amplitude_identity
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ}, 0 < n → k ≤ L → L + k ≤ n → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (L - k + 1))), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ (i : Fin (L - k + 1)), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (target source : Fin (L - k + 1)), MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L v lam target source * MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingFibreAmplitude n k L v target * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingSourceChannelCoefficient n k L source target) = MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L v lam target source ^ 2 * √lam * MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingFibreAmplitude n k L v source

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient_amplitude_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ}, 0 < n → k ≤ L → L + k ≤ n → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (L - k + 1))), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ (i : Fin (L - k + 1)), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (MetricCodes.hammingJacobiMatrix n k L)) v = lam • v → ∀ (source : Fin (L - k + 1)), ∑ target, MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L v lam target source * MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingFibreAmplitude n k L v target * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingSourceChannelCoefficient n k L source target) = √lam * MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingFibreAmplitude n k L v source

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ}, 0 < n → k ≤ L → L + k ≤ n → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (L - k + 1))), (∀ (i : Fin (L - k + 1)), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (target source : Fin (L - k + 1)), MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L v lam target source ^ 2 = MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingSourceChannelCoefficient n k L source target * MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingRecurrenceWeight n k L v target / (lam * MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingRecurrenceWeight n k L v source)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient_sq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ}, 0 < n → k ≤ L → L + k ≤ n → ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (L - k + 1))), (∀ (i : Fin (L - k + 1)), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (MetricCodes.hammingJacobiMatrix n k L)) v = lam • v → ∀ (source : Fin (L - k + 1)), ∑ target, MetricCodes.Boolean.hammingAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L v lam target source ^ 2 = 1

entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel k (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend f)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDot
entries.statement: {n k : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown
entries.statement: (n k : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n (k + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n (k + 1)), (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown n k) f = MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrict k (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend f))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown_matrix_rank
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ}, 2 * k < n → (LinearMap.toMatrix' (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown n k)).rank = n.choose k

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown_surjective
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ}, 2 * k < n → Function.Surjective ⇑(MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown n k)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend
entries.statement: {n k : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtendLinear
entries.statement: (n k : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k →ₗ[ℝ] MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend_injective
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ}, Function.Injective MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend_layerRestrict_of_level
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel k f → MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrict k f) = f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrict
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → (k : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrictLinear
entries.statement: (n k : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n →ₗ[ℝ] MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrict_layerExtend
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k), MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrict k (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend f) = f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp
entries.statement: (n k : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k →ₗ[ℝ] MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n (k + 1)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k), (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp n k) f = MetricCodes.Boolean.layerRestrict (k + 1) (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend f))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp_injective
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ}, 2 * k < n → Function.Injective ⇑(MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp n k)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp_layerDown_adjoint
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k) (g : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n (k + 1)), MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDot ((MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp n k) f) g = MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDot f ((MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown n k) g)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp_matrix_rank
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ}, 2 * k < n → (LinearMap.toMatrix' (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp n k)).rank = n.choose k

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp_toMatrix_transpose
entries.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), LinearMap.toMatrix' (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerUp n k) = (LinearMap.toMatrix' (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerDown n k)).transpose

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → Finset (Fin n) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → Fin n → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → Finset (Fin n) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt_raise
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f) S = ∑ b, MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt b f) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt_raiseAt_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (a b : Fin n), a ≠ b → ∀ (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt b f) S = MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt b (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a f) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt_raiseAt_self
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a f) S = if a ∈ S then 0 else f S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt_twist
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (a : Fin n) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x f) = MetricCodes.Boolean.sign (x a) • MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a f)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerLinear
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n →ₗ[ℝ] MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_add
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (f + g) = MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f + MetricCodes.Boolean.lower g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_harmonicEmbedding
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic k f → ∀ (r : ℕ), 2 * k + (r + 1) ≤ n → MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding k (r + 1) f) = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient n k (r + 1)) • MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding k r f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_raise_of_harmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic k f → ∀ (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f) S = (↑n - 2 * ↑k) * f S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_raise_sub_raise_lower
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f) S - MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f) S = (↑n - 2 * ↑S.card) * f S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_raise_sub_raise_lower_of_level
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel k f → ∀ (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f) S - MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f) S = (↑n - 2 * ↑k) * f S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_raised_succ_of_harmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic k f → ∀ (r : ℕ), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Boolean.raised f (r + 1)) = MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient n k (r + 1) • MetricCodes.Boolean.raised f r

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.lower_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (c • f) = c • MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisGramFeature
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {κ : Type u_2} → [Fintype κ] → {D d : ℕ} → MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily X D d → (X → κ → ℝ) → Matrix (κ × Fin D) (Fin D) ℝ → ℝ → X → EuclideanSpace ℝ ((κ × Fin D) × Fin D)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift
entries.statement: {κ : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → {ρ : Type u_3} → (κ → ℝ) → Matrix ι ρ ℝ → Matrix (κ × ι) ρ ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ρ] (z : κ → ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ρ ℝ) (C : Matrix ρ σ ℝ), MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift z (A * C) = MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift z A * C

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift_transpose_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [Fintype ρ] (z w : κ → ℝ) (A B : Matrix ι ρ ℝ), (MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift z A).transpose * MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift w B = (∑ a, z a * w a) • (A.transpose * B)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisResidual
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {κ : Type u_2} → [Fintype κ] → {D d : ℕ} → MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily X D d → (X → κ → ℝ) → Matrix (κ × Fin D) (Fin D) ℝ → ℝ → X → Matrix (κ × Fin D) (Fin D) ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisResidual_gram
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] {D d : ℕ} (P : MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily X D d) (axis : X → κ → ℝ) (B : Matrix (κ × Fin D) (Fin D) ℝ) (c lam : ℝ), B.transpose * B = 1 → (∀ (x : X), B.transpose * MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift (axis x) (P.projection x) = c • P.projection x) → c ^ 2 = lam → ∀ (x y : X), inner ℝ (MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisGramFeature P axis B c x) (MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisGramFeature P axis B c y) = (∑ a, axis x a * axis y a - lam) * P.overlap x y

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → {ρ : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → [Fintype ρ] → Matrix ι ρ ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (ι × ρ)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ρ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ρ] (A B : Matrix ι ρ ℝ), inner ℝ (MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature A) (MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature B) = (A.transpose * B).trace

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ρ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ρ] (c : ℝ) (A : Matrix ι ρ ℝ), MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature (c • A) = c • MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature A

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {ρ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ρ] (A B : Matrix ι ρ ℝ), MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature (A - B) = MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature A - MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixHilbertSchmidtFeature B

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.mem_harmonicLayer_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.LayerFunction n k), f ∈ MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicLayer n k ↔ MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic k (MetricCodes.Boolean.layerExtend f)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq f = 0 ↔ f = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), 0 ≤ MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq_raise_of_level
entries.statement: ∀ {n i : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel i f → MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f) = MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f) + (↑n - 2 * ↑i) * MetricCodes.Boolean.normSq f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raise
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → Finset (Fin n) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → Fin n → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → Finset (Fin n) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt_lower
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f) S = ∑ b, MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt b f) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt_lowerAt_self
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a f) S = if a ∈ S then f S else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt_twist
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (a : Fin n) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x f) = MetricCodes.Boolean.sign (x a) • MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a f)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseLinear
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n →ₗ[ℝ] MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseLinear_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseLinear n) f = MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raise_add
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (f + g) = MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f + MetricCodes.Boolean.raise g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raise_eq_zero_iff_of_level
entries.statement: ∀ {n i : ℕ}, 2 * i < n → ∀ (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel i f → (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f = 0 ↔ f = 0)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raise_harmonicEmbedding
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (r : ℕ), 2 * k + (r + 1) ≤ n → MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding k r f) = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient n k (r + 1)) • MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding k (r + 1) f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raise_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (c • f) = c • MetricCodes.Boolean.raise f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raised
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → ℕ → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.raised_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (r : ℕ), MetricCodes.Boolean.raised f (r + 1) = MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Boolean.raised f r)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sign
entries.statement: Bool → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sign_mul_eq_difference_indicator
entries.statement: ∀ (b c : Bool), MetricCodes.Boolean.sign b * MetricCodes.Boolean.sign c = 1 - 2 * if b ≠ c then 1 else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sign_mul_self
entries.statement: ∀ (b : Bool), MetricCodes.Boolean.sign b * MetricCodes.Boolean.sign b = 1

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_dot_lowerAt
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a f) (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a g) = ∑ S, ↑S.card * f S * g S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_dot_lowerAt_of_level
entries.statement: ∀ {n i : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel i f → ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a f) (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a g) = ↑i * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_dot_raiseAt
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a f) (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a g) = ∑ S, (↑n - ↑S.card) * f S * g S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_dot_raiseAt_of_level
entries.statement: ∀ {n i : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel i f → ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a f) (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a g) = (↑n - ↑i) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_dot_twist_lowerAt
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a g)) = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower g))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_dot_twist_raiseAt
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a g)) = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (MetricCodes.Boolean.raise g))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_mem_indicator
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : ℝ), (∑ a, if a ∈ S then x else 0) = ↑S.card * x

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_not_mem_indicator
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (z : ℝ), (∑ a, if a ∈ S then 0 else z) = (↑n - ↑S.card) * z

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.sum_sign_mul_eq_hammingDist
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x y : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n), ∑ a, MetricCodes.Boolean.sign (x a) * MetricCodes.Boolean.sign (y a) = ↑n - 2 * ↑(MetricCodes.hammingDist x y)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.toggle
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → Fin n → Finset (Fin n) → Finset (Fin n)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.toggleEquiv
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → Fin n → Finset (Fin n) ≃ Finset (Fin n)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.toggle_toggle
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.toggle a (MetricCodes.Boolean.toggle a S) = S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.twist
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → MetricCodes.BinaryWord n → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → Finset (Fin n) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.twist_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (c : ℝ) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x (c • f) = c • MetricCodes.Boolean.twist x f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.wordHarmonicEmbedding
entries.statement: {n : ℕ} → MetricCodes.BinaryWord n → ℕ → ℕ → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Boolean.wordHarmonicEmbedding_isometry
entries.statement: ∀ {n k : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic k g → ∀ (r : ℕ), 2 * k + r ≤ n → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.wordHarmonicEmbedding x k r f) (MetricCodes.Boolean.wordHarmonicEmbedding x k r g) = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.Feasible
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.Index
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → Type

entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → Type

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension_le_mul_choose
entries.statement: ∀ (n k L : ℕ), k ≤ L → L ≤ n / 2 → MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension n k L ≤ (n + 1) * n.choose L

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryEntropy_continuous
entries.statement: Continuous MetricCodes.binaryEntropy

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryEntropy_eq_binEntropy_div_log
entries.statement: ∀ (u : ℝ), MetricCodes.binaryEntropy u = Real.binEntropy u / Real.log 2

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryEntropy_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ (u : ℝ), MetricCodes.binaryEntropy u ≤ 1

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate_le_of_eventually
entries.statement: ∀ {δ r : ℝ} {u : ℕ → ℝ}, Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds r) → (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, Real.logb 2 ↑(MetricCodes.Hamming.codeNumber n ⌈δ * ↑n⌉₊) / ↑n ≤ u n) → MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate δ ≤ r

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate_le_of_eventually_windowFibreQuotient
entries.statement: ∀ {δ a b C : ℝ}, 0 < b → b < a → a ≤ 1 / 2 → 0 < C → (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(MetricCodes.Hamming.codeNumber n ⌈δ * ↑n⌉₊) ≤ C * MetricCodes.Hamming.windowFibreQuotient a b n) → MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate δ ≤ MetricCodes.binaryEntropy a - MetricCodes.binaryEntropy b

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate_le_of_positive_feasible_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {δ a b : ℝ}, MetricCodes.Hamming.Feasible δ a b → 0 < b → (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(MetricCodes.Hamming.codeNumber n ⌈δ * ↑n⌉₊) ≤ MetricCodes.Hamming.spectralPrefactor δ a b * MetricCodes.Hamming.windowFibreQuotient a b n) → MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate δ ≤ MetricCodes.binaryEntropy a - MetricCodes.binaryEntropy b

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate_le_variationalRate
entries.statement: ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate δ ≤ MetricCodes.Hamming.variationalRate δ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate_le_variationalRate_of_positive_feasible_bounds

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.finite_bound_of_projection_gram
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {n k L d : ℕ}, 0 < n → 0 < d → ∀ (C : Finset (MetricCodes.BinaryWord n)), MetricCodes.IsBinaryCode d C → ∀ (P : MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily (MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension n k L) (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension n k)) (q : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n → E), 0 < MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension n k → MetricCodes.Hamming.threshold n d < MetricCodes.Hamming.topEigenvalue n k L → (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, inner ℝ (q x) (q y) = (MetricCodes.hammingCorrelation x y - MetricCodes.Hamming.topEigenvalue n k L) * P.overlap x y) → ↑C.card ≤ (1 - MetricCodes.Hamming.threshold n d) / (MetricCodes.Hamming.topEigenvalue n k L - MetricCodes.Hamming.threshold n d) * (↑(MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension n k L) / ↑(MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension n k))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.finite_codeNumber_bound_of_projection_gram
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {n k L d : ℕ}, 0 < n → 0 < d → ∀ (P : MetricCodes.ProjectionFamily (MetricCodes.BinaryWord n) (MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension n k L) (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension n k)) (q : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n → E), 0 < MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension n k → MetricCodes.Hamming.threshold n d < MetricCodes.Hamming.topEigenvalue n k L → (∀ (x y : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n), inner ℝ (q x) (q y) = (MetricCodes.hammingCorrelation x y - MetricCodes.Hamming.topEigenvalue n k L) * P.overlap x y) → ↑(MetricCodes.Hamming.codeNumber n d) ≤ (1 - MetricCodes.Hamming.threshold n d) / (MetricCodes.Hamming.topEigenvalue n k L - MetricCodes.Hamming.threshold n d) * (↑(MetricCodes.Hamming.ambientDimension n k L) / ↑(MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension n k))

entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → a < 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.logb 2 ↑(n.choose (MetricCodes.Hamming.longitudinalDegree a n)) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds (MetricCodes.binaryEntropy a))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.tendsto_logb_const_mul_windowFibreQuotient

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.tendsto_logb_succ_div

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.tendsto_longitudinal_ratio

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.terminal_edge_sum_le_top

entries.statement: ∀ (d m : ℕ), m ≤ d → ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ), ∑ p ∈ Finset.range d, c p * MetricCodes.Hamming.terminalIndicator d m p * MetricCodes.Hamming.terminalIndicator d m (p + 1) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range m, c (d - m + r)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Hamming.terminal_indicator_sum

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.booleanHarmonicDimension_mul_degreeComplement
entries.statement: ∀ (n j : ℕ), 2 * j ≤ n → ↑(MetricCodes.booleanHarmonicDimension n j) * (↑n - ↑j + 1) = ↑(n.choose j) * (↑n - 2 * ↑j + 1)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.booleanHarmonicDimension_succ_div

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.booleanHarmonicDimension_succ_div_eq_upperScale
entries.statement: ∀ {n j : ℕ}, 2 * (j + 1) ≤ n → ↑(MetricCodes.booleanHarmonicDimension n (j + 1)) / ↑(MetricCodes.booleanHarmonicDimension n j) = MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonUpperScale n j / (↑j + 1)

entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (x y : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), ∑ i, (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator (↑x) i - ↑w / ↑n) * (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator (↑y) i - ↑w / ↑n) = ↑(MetricCodes.wordSupport ↑x ∩ MetricCodes.wordSupport ↑y).card - ↑w ^ 2 / ↑n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCenteredAxis_sum
entries.statement: ∀ (w N p q t : ℕ) (c : ℝ), ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * (↑(p + ↑r) - c * ↑(p + q + t)) = (↑p - c * ↑(p + q + t)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t + MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCenteredAxis_sum_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → ∀ (c : ℝ), ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * (↑(p + ↑r) - c * ↑(p + q + t)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t * (↑p - c * ↑(p + q + t) + ↑t * (↑N - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) / (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 2))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCenteredExpectation_eq_johnsonDiagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), ↑p + MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w (n - w) p q ↑source / MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q ↑source - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + ↑source) = MetricCodes.johnsonDiagonal n w p q (p + q + ↑source) * (↑w * ↑(n - w) * (↑n - 2 * ↑(p + q + ↑source)) / (↑n * (↑n - 2 * ↑w)))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschClosedCenteredExpectation_eq_johnsonDiagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), ↑p - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + ↑source) + ↑↑source * (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q - ↑↑source + 1) / (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑↑source + 2) = MetricCodes.johnsonDiagonal n w p q (p + q + ↑source) * (↑w * ↑(n - w) * (↑n - 2 * ↑(p + q + ↑source)) / (↑n * (↑n - 2 * ↑w)))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient_cross_degree_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t r : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → r ≤ t → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q (t + 1) r * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1 - r)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t r * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient_sq_cross_degree_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t r : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ N → r ≤ t → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q (t + 1) r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1 - r) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient_sq_harmonic_balance
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p ↑r = ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t - ↑r)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient_sq_succ_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t r : ℕ}, 2 * p + (r + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t (r + 1) ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t - r)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient_sq_weighted_harmonic_balance
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → ∑ r, (↑↑r - 1) * (MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p ↑r) = ∑ r, ↑↑r * (MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t - ↑r))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient_succ_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t r : ℕ}, 2 * p + (r + 1) ≤ w → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t (r + 1) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1)) = -MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t r * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t - r))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w N p q t = ↑t * (↑N - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t / (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 2)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 2) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w N p q t = ↑t * (↑N - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq_cross_degree_harmonic_balance
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ N → MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t = ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q (t + 1) ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1 - ↑r)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq_div_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ N → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t / MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q (t + 1) = (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - ↑t + 1) * (↑w - 2 * ↑p - ↑t) / ((↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 1) * (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq_pos
entries.statement: ∀ (w N p q t : ℕ), 0 < MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq_succ_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ N → MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t * ((↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 1) * (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q (t + 1) * ((↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - ↑t + 1) * (↑w - 2 * ↑p - ↑t))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSecondMoment
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSecondMoment_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ N → (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 3) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSecondMoment w N p q t = (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑N - 2 * ↑q) * ↑t - ↑t ^ 2 + ↑t + 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSignedAdjacentCross_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ N → ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (↑r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q (t + 1) (↑r + 1) = -√(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSignedAdjacentCross_sum_comm
entries.statement: ∀ {w N p q t : ℕ}, 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ N → ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q (t + 1) (↑r + 1) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (↑r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r = -√(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebsch_complement_moment_expansion
entries.statement: ∀ (w N p q t : ℕ), ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient N q (t - ↑r) = ↑t * (↑N - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w N p q t + (2 * ↑t - (↑N - 2 * ↑q) - 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w N p q t - MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSecondMoment w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.clebsch_support_moment_expansion
entries.statement: ∀ (w N p q t : ℕ), ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w N p q t ↑r ^ 2 * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p ↑r = (↑w - 2 * ↑p + 1) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschFirstMoment w N p q t - MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschSecondMoment w N p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction
entries.statement: {n w q : ℕ} → (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) → 2 * q ≤ n - w → Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q) → ℕ → Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction_eq_zero_of_card_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {n w q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q)) (r : ℕ) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x)), S.card ≠ q + r → MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a r S = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction_lower
entries.statement: ∀ {n w q r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * q + (r + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q)) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x)), MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateLower (MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a (r + 1)) S = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a r S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction_lower_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {n w q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q)) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x)), MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateLower (MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a 0) S = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction_orthonormal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w q r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * q + r ≤ n - w → ∀ (a b : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q)), ∑ S, MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a r S * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq b r S = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction_pairing
entries.statement: ∀ {n w q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a b : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q)) (r s : ℕ), ∑ S, MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a r S * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq b s S = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding q r (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicBasisFunction (n - w) q hq a)) (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding q s (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicBasisFunction (n - w) q hq b))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction_raise
entries.statement: ∀ {n w q r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * q + (r + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension (n - w) q)) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x)), MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateRaise (MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a r) S = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a (r + 1) S

entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), x ≠ 0 → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) x = MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L • x → MetricCodes.Johnson.rayleigh n w p q L (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateAbs p q L x) = MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv_card
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (S : Finset (Fin n)), ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1.card + ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2.card = S.card

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv_erase_complement
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x) (S : Finset (Fin n)), (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) (S.erase ↑i) = (((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1, ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2.erase i)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv_erase_support
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x) (S : Finset (Fin n)), (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) (S.erase ↑i) = (((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1.erase i, ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2)

entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.ComplementCoordinates x) (S : Finset (Fin n)), (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) (insert (↑i) S) = (((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1, insert i ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv_insert_support
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x) (S : Finset (Fin n)), (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) (insert (↑i) S) = (insert i ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1, ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation
entries.statement: {n w : ℕ} → MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w → MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation_eq_hamming
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ}, 0 < w → w < n → ∀ (x y : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation x y = 1 - ↑n * ↑(MetricCodes.hammingDist ↑x ↑y) / (2 * ↑w * ↑(n - w))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation_le_threshold
entries.statement: ∀ {n w d : ℕ}, 0 < w → w < n → ∀ {x y : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w}, d ≤ MetricCodes.hammingDist ↑x ↑y → MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation x y ≤ MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation_le_threshold_of_code
entries.statement: ∀ {n w d : ℕ}, 0 < w → w < n → ∀ {C : Finset (MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w)}, MetricCodes.Johnson.IsCode d C → ∀ {x y : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w}, x ∈ C → y ∈ C → x ≠ y → MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation x y ≤ MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation_self

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledDegreeCoordinates_pairing
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (a b : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), ∑ u, MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledDegreeCoordinates h x i a u * MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledDegreeCoordinates h x i b u = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.statement: {n w p q L : ℕ} → MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w → (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) → MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q → ↥(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEuclideanLayer n (p + q + ↑i))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a b : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq b t) = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic_dot_of_split_proportional
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (∀ (r : Fin (t + 1)), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (↑r) (t - ↑r)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 t)) → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic_isHarmonic

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic_isLevel
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (t : ℕ), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel (p + q + t) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor
entries.statement: {n w p q : ℕ} → MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w → 2 * p ≤ w → 2 * q ≤ n - w → MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q → ℕ → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a b : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor x hp hq a t) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor x hp hq b t) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t * if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor_isLevel
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (t : ℕ), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel (p + q + t) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor_lower_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor x hp hq a t) = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.dot_fintype_weighted_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (c : ι → ℝ) (d : κ → ℝ) (f : ι → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (g : κ → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (fun S => ∑ i, c i * f i S) fun S => ∑ j, d j * g j S) = ∑ i, ∑ j, c i * d j * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (f i) (g j)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.eventually_projectionGram
entries.statement: ∀ {d a b g u : ℝ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.Feasible d a b g u → ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, Nonempty (MetricCodes.Johnson.ProjectionGram n (MetricCodes.Johnson.Asymptotics.shellWeight a n) (MetricCodes.Johnson.Asymptotics.supportDegree b n) (MetricCodes.Johnson.Asymptotics.complementDegree g n) (MetricCodes.Johnson.Asymptotics.terminalDegree u n))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_binaryCodeNumber

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_binaryRate_mrrw_improvement

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_mrrw_minimizer
entries.statement: ∀ {δ : ℝ}, δ ≤ 1 / 2 → ∃ r, 0 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ 1 - 2 * δ ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 - 2 * δ → MetricCodes.Johnson.mrrwObjective δ r ≤ MetricCodes.Johnson.mrrwObjective δ s

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_nonnegative_topEigenvector
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) x = MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L • x ∧ ∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 ≤ x.ofLp i

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_nonnegative_unit_topEigenvector
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∃ x, ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) x = MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L • x ∧ ∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 ≤ x.ofLp i

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_positive_unit_topEigenvector
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∃ v, ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L • v ∧ ∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_shellCodeNumber
entries.statement: ∀ (n w d : ℕ), ∃ C ⊆ MetricCodes.weightShell n w, MetricCodes.IsBinaryCode d C ∧ C.card = MetricCodes.Johnson.shellCodeNumber n w d

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.exists_topEigenvector
entries.statement: ∀ (n w p q L : ℕ), ∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) x = MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L • x

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.finite_binaryCodeNumber_bound_of_projection_gram
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L d : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 0 < d → ∀ (data : MetricCodes.Johnson.ProjectionGram n w p q L), MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d < MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L → ↑(MetricCodes.Johnson.binaryCodeNumber n d) ≤ 2 ^ n / ↑(n.choose w) * ((1 - MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d) / (MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L - MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d) * (↑(MetricCodes.johnsonAmbientDimension n (p + q) L) / ↑(MetricCodes.johnsonFibreDimension n w p q)))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.finite_bound_of_projection_gram
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L d : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 0 < d → ∀ (data : MetricCodes.Johnson.ProjectionGram n w p q L) (C : Finset (MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w)), MetricCodes.Johnson.IsCode d C → MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d < MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L → ↑C.card ≤ (1 - MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d) / (MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L - MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d) * (↑(MetricCodes.johnsonAmbientDimension n (p + q) L) / ↑(MetricCodes.johnsonFibreDimension n w p q))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.finite_shellCodeNumber_bound_of_projection_gram
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L d : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 0 < d → ∀ (data : MetricCodes.Johnson.ProjectionGram n w p q L), MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d < MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L → ↑(MetricCodes.Johnson.shellCodeNumber n w d) ≤ (1 - MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d) / (MetricCodes.Johnson.topEigenvalue n w p q L - MetricCodes.Johnson.threshold n w d) * (↑(MetricCodes.johnsonAmbientDimension n (p + q) L) / ↑(MetricCodes.johnsonFibreDimension n w p q))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.globalHarmonicVector

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.globalHarmonicVector_harmonicBasisFunction
entries.statement: ∀ {n j : ℕ} (hj : 2 * j ≤ n) (a : Fin (MetricCodes.booleanHarmonicDimension n j)), MetricCodes.Johnson.globalHarmonicVector (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicBasisFunction n j hj a) ⋯ = (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicOrthonormalBasis n j hj) a

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.globalHarmonicVector_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {n j : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (hf : MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic j f) (hg : MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic j g), inner ℝ (MetricCodes.Johnson.globalHarmonicVector f hf) (MetricCodes.Johnson.globalHarmonicVector g hg) = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.hattedDiagonal_nonneg

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.hattedEdge_pos

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.inner_le_inner_coordinateAbs
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), inner ℝ ((MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) x) x ≤ inner ℝ ((MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateAbs p q L x)) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateAbs p q L x)
