entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → (p q L : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L → ℝ → MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L → MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient_amplitude_identity
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target source * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreAmplitude n w p q L v target * √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) = MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target source ^ 2 * √lam * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreAmplitude n w p q L v source

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient_amplitude_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → ∀ (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), ∑ target, MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target source * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreAmplitude n w p q L v target * √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) = √lam * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreAmplitude n w p q L v source

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target source ^ 2 = MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonRecurrenceWeight n w p q L v target / (lam * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonRecurrenceWeight n w p q L v source)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient_sq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → ∀ (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), ∑ target, MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target source ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → ℕ → (p q L : ℕ) → MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L → MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → MetricCodes.Boolean.CoordinateFunction n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_axis_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L), 2 * w < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_axis_inner_diagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L), 2 * w < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L source source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source source) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_axis_inner_of_not_active
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), ¬MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelActive p q L target source → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_coordinate_axisDot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (hf : MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), ∑ k, ∑ b, (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp k * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonHarmonicCoordinates ⋯ (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f k) ⋯ b * MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledDegreeCoordinates h x target a b = MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_eq_zero_of_not_active
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), ¬MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelActive p q L target source → MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_isHarmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : Fin n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑target) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f a)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_isometry
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelActive p q L target source → ∀ (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) g → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source g) = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel_orthogonal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (target source other : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), source ≠ other → ∀ (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑other) g → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target other g) = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ}, 0 < w → w < n → 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → 0 < MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar n w p q t

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ}, 0 < w → w < n → 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar n w p q t ^ 2 = ↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (t + 1) * (MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t / MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar_sq_degree_factored
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), ↑target + 1 = ↑source → MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentRawScalar n w p q ↑target ^ 2 = ↑n * (↑w - ↑(p + q + ↑target) - ↑p + ↑q) * (↑(n - w) - ↑(p + q + ↑target) + ↑p - ↑q) * (↑(p + q + ↑target) - ↑p - ↑q + 1) * (↑n - ↑p - ↑q - ↑(p + q + ↑target) + 1) / (↑w * ↑(n - w) * (↑n - 2 * ↑(p + q + ↑target)) * (↑n - 2 * ↑(p + q + ↑target) + 1))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower
entries.statement: {n w : ℕ} → MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower_coupledHarmonic_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a (t + 1))) = (√(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1)))⁻¹ * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t))⁻¹ * ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q (t + 1) (↑r + 1) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (↑r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower_coupledHarmonic_dot_closed
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a (t + 1))) = -√(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (t + 1)) * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t) / √(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1))) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower_eq_support
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower x f = √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) • (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x f - (↑w / ↑n) • MetricCodes.Boolean.lower f)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower_eq_support_of_harmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n w j : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic j f → MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisLower x f = √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) • MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership
entries.statement: {n w : ℕ} → MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x f S = (∑ a, if a ∈ S then (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp a else 0) * f S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership_coupledHarmonic_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (t : ℕ) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t))⁻¹ * √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r * (↑(p + ↑r) - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + t)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (↑r) (t - ↑r))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership_coupledHarmonic_dot_of_split_proportional
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (∀ (r : Fin (t + 1)), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (↑r) (t - ↑r)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 t)) → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (↑p - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + t) + ↑t * (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) / (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 2)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership_coupledTensor
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (t : ℕ), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor x hp hq a t) = fun S => ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r * (√(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (↑(p + ↑r) - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + t))) * MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (↑r) (t - ↑r) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership_smul
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (c : ℝ) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x (c • f) = c • MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x f

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership_splitTensor
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (r s : ℕ), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisMembership x (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) = (√(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (↑(p + r) - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + r + (q + s)))) • MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise_coupledHarmonic_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + (t + 1)) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = (√(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t))⁻¹ * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1)))⁻¹ * ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (↑r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q (t + 1) (↑r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a (t + 1))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise_coupledHarmonic_dot_closed
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + (t + 1)) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = -√(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (t + 1)) * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t) / √(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1))) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a (t + 1))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise_dot_harmonic_left
entries.statement: ∀ {n w j : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic j f → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisRaise x g) = √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportRaise x g)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelMatrix_transpose_axis_fibre
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → (∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)) → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam).transpose * MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift (fun k => (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp k) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreMatrix h v x) = √lam • MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreMatrix h v x

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelMatrix_transpose_axis_projection
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L) (hv : ∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → (∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)) → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam).transpose * MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift (fun k => (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp k) ((MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonProjectionFamily h v hv).projection x) = √lam • (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonProjectionFamily h v hv).projection x

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonDot_fintype_weighted_sum_right
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n) (c : ι → ℝ) (g : ι → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f fun S => ∑ i, c i * g i S) = ∑ i, c i * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (g i)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonEdge_sq_factored
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L j : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → p + q ≤ j → j < MetricCodes.johnsonLastDegree n w p q → MetricCodes.johnsonEdge n w p q j ^ 2 = ↑n ^ 2 * ((↑w - ↑j) * (↑(n - w) - ↑j) * (↑w - ↑j - ↑p + ↑q) * (↑(n - w) - ↑j + ↑p - ↑q) * (↑j - ↑p - ↑q + 1) * (↑n - ↑p - ↑q - ↑j + 1)) / ((↑w * ↑(n - w)) ^ 2 * (↑n - 2 * ↑j) ^ 2 * ((↑n - 2 * ↑j - 1) * (↑n - 2 * ↑j + 1)))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreAmplitude_sq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∑ i, MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonFibreAmplitude n w p q L v i ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonHarmonic_dot_coupledHarmonic
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 t)

entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → ∀ r ≤ t, MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r (t - r)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t r * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonHarmonic_dot_splitTensor_succ_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → r < t → √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (r + 1) (t - (r + 1))) = -√(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (t - r)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r (t - r))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonLowerChannel_coupled_axis_inner_closed
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + (t + 1)) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonLowerChannel (p + q + (t + 1)) f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = -(√↑(p + q + (t + 1)))⁻¹ * √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (t + 1)) * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t) / √(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1))) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a (t + 1))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleChannel_coupled_axis_inner_closed
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleChannel (p + q + t) f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleScale n (p + q + t)))⁻¹ * √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (↑p - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + t) + ↑t * (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) / (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 2)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + t ≤ w → 2 * q + t ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (∀ (r : Fin (t + 1)), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (↑r) (t - ↑r)) = MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q t ↑r * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 t)) → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleChannel (p + q + t) f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)) = (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleScale n (p + q + t)))⁻¹ * √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (↑p - ↑w / ↑n * ↑(p + q + t) + ↑t * (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q - ↑t + 1) / (↑w - 2 * ↑p + (↑(n - w) - 2 * ↑q) - 2 * ↑t + 2)) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleChannel_signed_axis_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L), 2 * w < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), 0 < p + q + ↑source → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonDiagonalChannelSign n w p q (p + q + ↑source) • MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleChannel (p + q + ↑source) f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source source) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)

entries.statement: ∀ {n j k : ℕ} (f g : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic k g → ∀ (a : Fin n), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonMiddleRaw j a f) g = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Boolean.raiseAt a (MetricCodes.Boolean.lowerAt a g)) - ↑j / ↑n * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f g

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonNu_denominator_factor

entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q j : ℕ}, w ≤ n → (MetricCodes.johnsonJ n j ^ 2 - MetricCodes.johnsonM n w ^ 2) * (MetricCodes.johnsonJ n j ^ 2 - MetricCodes.johnsonDelta n w p q ^ 2) * ((MetricCodes.johnsonSigma n w p q + 1) ^ 2 - MetricCodes.johnsonJ n j ^ 2) = (↑w - ↑j) * (↑(n - w) - ↑j) * (↑w - ↑j - ↑p + ↑q) * (↑(n - w) - ↑j + ↑p - ↑q) * (↑j - ↑p - ↑q + 1) * (↑n - ↑p - ↑q - ↑j + 1)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonProjectionGramFeature_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L) (hv : ∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → (∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)) → ∀ (x y : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), inner ℝ (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonProjectionGramFeature h hstrict v hv lam x) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonProjectionGramFeature h hstrict v hv lam y) = (MetricCodes.Johnson.correlation x y - lam) * (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonProjectionFamily h v hv).overlap x y

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower_coupledTensor_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledTensor x hp hq a (t + 1)) = fun S => ∑ r, MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschCoefficient w (n - w) p q (t + 1) (↑r + 1) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (↑r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (↑r) (t - ↑r) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower_fintype_weighted_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x fun S => ∑ i, c i * f i S) = fun S => ∑ i, c i * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x (f i) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower_smul

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower_splitTensor_succ
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q r s : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (r + 1) ≤ w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (r + 1) s) = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1)) • MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower_splitTensor_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q s : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSupportLower x (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a 0 s) = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonUpperChannel_coupled_axis_inner_closed
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q t : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (t + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (t + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + t) f → MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonUpperChannel (p + q + t) f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a (t + 1))) = -(√(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonUpperScale n (p + q + t)))⁻¹ * √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (t + 1)) * (√(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q t) / √(MetricCodes.Johnson.clebschNormSq w (n - w) p q (t + 1))) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x hp hq a t)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowBasis_dot
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (a b : Fin (MetricCodes.booleanHarmonicDimension n (p + q + ↑source))), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowBasis h ⟨source, a⟩) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowBasis h ⟨source, b⟩) = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (b : Fin (MetricCodes.booleanHarmonicDimension n (p + q + ↑source))), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowBasis h ⟨source, b⟩) (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source) = MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledDegreeCoordinates h x source a b

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix_pairing
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L) (lam : ℝ) (Q R : MetricCodes.Johnson.ShellWindowIndex n p q L), ∑ T, MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam T Q * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam T R = ∑ target, MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target Q.fst * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentBlockCoefficient n w p q L v lam target R.fst * MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target Q.fst (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowBasis h Q)) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target R.fst (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowBasis h R))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix_transpose_axis_fibre
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → (∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (target source : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L) (f : MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsHarmonic (p + q + ↑source) f → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.coordinateDot (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAdjacentChannel n w p q L target source f) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonAxisTensor x (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑target)) = √(MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonSourceChannelCoefficient n w p q L source target) * MetricCodes.Boolean.dot f (MetricCodes.Johnson.coupledHarmonic x ⋯ ⋯ a ↑source)) → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam).transpose * MetricCodes.Boolean.matrixAxisLift (fun k => (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp k) (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowFibreMatrix h v x) = √lam • MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowFibreMatrix h v x

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix_transpose_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (hstrict : 2 * w < n) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = lam • v → (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam).transpose * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowChannelMatrix h hstrict v lam = 1

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowFibreMatrix_transpose_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ} (h : MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L) (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L), (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i) → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), (MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowFibreMatrix h v x).transpose * MetricCodes.Johnson.johnsonWindowFibreMatrix h v x = 1

entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L j : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → j < w → MetricCodes.johnsonZonalEdge n w j ^ 2 = ↑n ^ 2 * ((↑w - ↑j) ^ 2 * (↑(n - w) - ↑j) ^ 2 * (↑j + 1) * (↑n - ↑j + 1)) / ((↑w * ↑(n - w)) ^ 2 * (↑n - 2 * ↑j) ^ 2 * ((↑n - 2 * ↑j - 1) * (↑n - 2 * ↑j + 1)))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.lower_fintype_weighted_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → MetricCodes.Boolean.Function n), (MetricCodes.Boolean.lower fun S => ∑ i, c i * f i S) = fun S => ∑ i, c i * MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (f i) S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.lower_splitTensor
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (r s : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.lower (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) S = MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateLower (MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a.1 r) ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1 * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a.2 s ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2 + MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a.1 r ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1 * MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateLower (MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a.2 s) ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.main_binary_theorem
entries.statement: ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate δ ≤ MetricCodes.Johnson.combinedVariationalRate δ ∧ MetricCodes.Johnson.combinedVariationalRate δ < MetricCodes.Johnson.mrrwRate δ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.mrrw_endpoint_dichotomy

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.nonnegative_eigenvector_coordinate_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L) (eigenvalue : ℝ), (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = eigenvalue • v → (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 ≤ v.ofLp i) → v ≠ 0 → ∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 < v.ofLp i

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.nonnegative_eigenvector_zero_propagates
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q L : ℕ}, MetricCodes.Johnson.AdmissibleDegrees n w p q L → 2 * w < n → ∀ (v : MetricCodes.Johnson.Space p q L) (eigenvalue : ℝ), (MetricCodes.Johnson.operator n w p q L) v = eigenvalue • v → (∀ (i : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), 0 ≤ v.ofLp i) → ∀ (i j : MetricCodes.Johnson.Index p q L), v.ofLp i = 0 → ↑i + 1 = ↑j ∨ ↑j + 1 = ↑i → v.ofLp j = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.raise_splitTensor
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (r s : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)), MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) S = MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateRaise (MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a.1 r) ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1 * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a.2 s ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2 + MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a.1 r ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1 * MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateRaise (MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a.2 s) ((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).2

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.raise_splitTensor_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q r s : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + (r + 1) ≤ w → 2 * q + (s + 1) ≤ n - w → ∀ (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.raise (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1)) • MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a (r + 1) s + √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient (n - w) q (s + 1)) • MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r (s + 1)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor_cross_orthogonal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a b : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (r s r' s' : ℕ), r ≠ r' → MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq b r' s') = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor_isLevel
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (r s : ℕ), MetricCodes.Boolean.IsLevel (p + r + (q + s)) (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor_orthonormal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q r s : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w), 2 * p + r ≤ w → 2 * q + s ≤ n - w → ∀ (a b : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq b r s) = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor_pairing
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p q : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (hq : 2 * q ≤ n - w) (a b : MetricCodes.Johnson.HarmonicFibreIndex n w p q) (r s r' s' : ℕ), MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq a r s) (MetricCodes.Johnson.splitTensor x hp hq b r' s') = (∑ A, MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a.1 r A * MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp b.1 r' A) * ∑ B, MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq a.2 s B * MetricCodes.Johnson.complementRaisedFunction x hq b.2 s' B

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sqrt_one_sub_centeredDegree_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {u : ℝ}, 0 < u → u < 1 / 2 → √(1 - MetricCodes.Johnson.centeredDegree u ^ 2) = 2 * √(u * (1 - u))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sum_coordinateIndicator
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n), ∑ i, MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator x i = ↑(MetricCodes.binaryWeight x)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sum_coordinateIndicator_mul
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (x y : MetricCodes.BinaryWord n), ∑ i, MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator x i * MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator y i = ↑(MetricCodes.wordSupport x ∩ MetricCodes.wordSupport y).card

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sum_coordinateIndicator_mul_function
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (F : Fin n → ℝ), ∑ i, MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator (↑x) i * F i = ∑ i, F ↑i

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sum_coordinateIndicator_on_subset
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (S : Finset (Fin n)), (∑ a, if a ∈ S then MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateIndicator (↑x) a else 0) = ↑((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1.card

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sum_geometricAxis
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w), ∑ a, (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp a = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.sum_geometricAxis_on_subset
entries.statement: ∀ {n w : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (S : Finset (Fin n)), (∑ a, if a ∈ S then (MetricCodes.Johnson.geometricAxis x).ofLp a else 0) = √(↑n / (↑w * ↑(n - w))) * (↑((MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateSplitEquiv x) S).1.card - ↑w / ↑n * ↑S.card)

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction
entries.statement: {n w p : ℕ} → (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) → 2 * p ≤ w → Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p) → ℕ → Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x) → ℝ

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_cross_orthogonal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (a b : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)) (r s : ℕ), r ≠ s → ∑ S, MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a r S * MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp b s S = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_eq_zero_of_card_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)) (r : ℕ) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x)), S.card ≠ p + r → MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a r S = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_lower
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w), 2 * p + (r + 1) ≤ w → ∀ (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x)), MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateLower (MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a (r + 1)) S = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a r S

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_lower_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x)), MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateLower (MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a 0) S = 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_orthonormal
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w), 2 * p + r ≤ w → ∀ (a b : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)), ∑ S, MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a r S * MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp b r S = if a = b then 1 else 0

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_pairing
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w) (a b : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)) (r s : ℕ), ∑ S, MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a r S * MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp b s S = MetricCodes.Boolean.dot (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding p r (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicBasisFunction w p hp a)) (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicEmbedding p s (MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicBasisFunction w p hp b))

entries.name: MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction_raise
entries.statement: ∀ {n w p r : ℕ} (x : MetricCodes.JohnsonSphere n w) (hp : 2 * p ≤ w), 2 * p + (r + 1) ≤ w → ∀ (a : Fin (MetricCodes.hammingFibreDimension w p)) (S : Finset (MetricCodes.Johnson.SupportCoordinates x)), MetricCodes.Johnson.coordinateRaise (MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a r) S = √(MetricCodes.Boolean.harmonicCoefficient w p (r + 1)) * MetricCodes.Johnson.supportRaisedFunction x hp a (r + 1) S

entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n), k < L → ∀ (target source : SpherePacking.Jacobi.Index k L), SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.sourceAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L hn target source * (SpherePacking.HarmonicCertificateAssembly.harmonicFibreAmplitudes n k L hn).ofLp target * √(SpherePacking.SourceJacobiWeights.sourceChannelCoefficient n k L source target) = SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.sourceAdjacentBlockCoefficient n k L hn target source ^ 2 * √(SpherePacking.Jacobi.topEigenvalue n k L) * (SpherePacking.HarmonicCertificateAssembly.harmonicFibreAmplitudes n k L hn).ofLp source

entries.statement: ∀ {n k L : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (fibre : SpherePacking.Euclidean n → SpherePacking.CertificateFibre n k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] SpherePacking.CertificateAmbient n k L) (source : SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.SourceSpectralRowData n k L fibre) (x y : SpherePacking.Euclidean n), y ∈ SpherePacking.unitSphere n → ∀ (i : Fin (SpherePacking.Gegenbauer.fibreDimension n k)), inner ℝ ((SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.bulkCoordinateMap hn (SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.spectralMatrixEmbedding n k L source.row) fibre x) ((SpherePacking.certificateFibreBasis n k) i)) ((SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.liftCoordinateMap hn fibre y) ((SpherePacking.certificateFibreBasis n k) i)) = source.spectralCoefficient * inner ℝ ((SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.bulkCoordinateMap hn (SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.spectralMatrixEmbedding n k L source.row) fibre x) ((SpherePacking.certificateFibreBasis n k) i)) ((SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.bulkCoordinateMap hn (SpherePacking.HarmonicCoordinateChannels.spectralMatrixEmbedding n k L source.row) fibre y) ((SpherePacking.certificateFibreBasis n k) i))
